`notebook-output.png` was captured on 2026-10-31 from the Windows
System.Drawing PNG encoder. It is a 2 by 2 bitmap with red, green, blue and
white pixels, created with `Bitmap.SetPixel` and saved with
`Bitmap.Save(path, ImageFormat.Png)`. The 130-byte encoder output is retained
verbatim. Tests use these real encoded image bytes without provider requests.
